editorial:
The Lawless Frontier is a John Wayne B-western released November 22, 1934, distributed by Monogram Pictures. Robert N. Bradbury directed from his own screenplay. The cast includes Sheila Terry, George "Gabby" Hayes, Earl Dwire, Yakima Canutt and Gordon De Main. It suits Wayne retrospectives, early-western clip reels and Hayes or Canutt compilations.

The copyright status is not settled. Renewal for a 1934 work was due in 1961 or 1962. Only parts of those two Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes were read, so a renewal was neither found nor ruled out. The 1934 registration, title variants and the Copyright Office catalog were not checked. The score and source story were not checked either. Check all of this by hand before you rely on it.
